title: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 扩层训练范围

standard.summary: 控制扩层后哪些参数参与训练：new_layers 只训练新增层（标准 DUS 配方）；new_layers_periphery 额外训练外围模块；all 训练全部参数。
standard.effect: new_layers：冻结原有层，只有新增层可训练；new_layers_periphery：在此基础上解冻 patch_embedding、condition_embedder、proj_out 与顶层 scale_shift_table；all：整个 DiT 参与训练（成本最高）。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 new_layers 最稳；需要输入/输出适配一起动时用 new_layers_periphery；数据充足且资源允许时才考虑 all。
standard.avoidWhen: all 范围显存开销最大且容易破坏原模型能力，小数据集慎用。

standard_en.summary: Controls which parameters take part in training after expansion: new_layers trains only the new layers (the standard DUS recipe); new_layers_periphery additionally trains the peripheral modules; all trains every parameter.
standard_en.effect: new_layers: the original layers are frozen and only the new layers are trainable; new_layers_periphery: on top of that it unfreezes patch_embedding, condition_embedder, proj_out and the top-level scale_shift_table; all: the whole DiT takes part in training (the most expensive).
standard_en.whenToUse: The default new_layers is the most stable; use new_layers_periphery when the input/output adaptation needs to move too; only consider all when you have plenty of data and the resources allow it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: The all scope costs the most VRAM and can easily damage the original model's ability, so use it carefully on a small dataset.

advanced.principle: 冻结源层保持原有能力不漂移，新增层从恒等起点学习增量容量；外围模块解冻用于适配新深度下的输入输出分布。
advanced.intervention: wan22/wan22_depth_expansion_runtime.py：apply_train_scope 按元数据设置 requires_grad 并输出 trainable_ratio。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练范围越大可塑性越强、成本与遗忘风险也越高。
advanced.tradeoffs: new_layers 最省显存但容量增量有限；all 等价于扩层后全参微调。

advanced_en.principle: Freezing the source layers keeps original capabilities from drifting, while the new layers learn incremental capacity from the identity starting point; peripheral modules are unfrozen to adapt to the input/output distribution at the new depth.
advanced_en.intervention: wan22/wan22_depth_expansion_runtime.py: apply_train_scope sets requires_grad per the metadata and reports trainable_ratio.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The larger the training scope, the greater the plasticity — and the cost and forgetting risk.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: new_layers is the most VRAM-frugal but has limited capacity gain; all is equivalent to full-parameter finetuning after expansion.
